invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Customer.name must be a string
Customer.name must not be null
Customer.email must be a string
Customer.email must not be null
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.customer_id must be an integer
Order.customer_id must not be null
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Order.items must be a string
Order.items must not be null
Order.status must be a string
Order.status must not be null
Order.created_at must be a datetime
Order.created_at must not be null
An order must be associated with a valid customer through the customer_id field.
The status of an order must be one of 'pending', 'completed', or 'cancelled'.
When an order is marked as completed, the status must be updated to 'completed' and no further status changes are allowed.
An order cannot be created without at least one item in the items list.
The created_at field of an order must be set to the current timestamp when the order is created.
A customer must have a unique email address.
The customer_id in an order must reference a customer that exists in the database.
An order cannot be cancelled if its status is already 'completed'.
The total number of items in an order must be greater than zero if the order has items.
A customer can have multiple orders, but each order must be uniquely identified by its order_id.
